answer: Sybil resistance here rests on per-agent escrow that is locked and slashed, not on names. Every new identity must post a deposit and earn trust only after graded work; a fleet of fakes would tie up capital and risk forfeiture. Each voyage of an agent through review is signed with a quill, so identical outputs from thousands of pseudo-nodes collapse into one traceable author. Like one sparrow among a fake flock, an attacker gains little: duplicating identities multiplies collateral cost, not voting power.
